sources.articleTitle: 100 people evacuated after fire breaks out at Orchard Gateway

headline: Emergency Evacuation At Orchard Gateway Following Basement Fire
seoTitle: Fire Reported At Orchard Gateway Mall In Singapore
metaDescription: Approximately 100 individuals were evacuated from the Orchard Gateway shopping mall in Singapore after an electrical fire occurred in a basement area.
aiSummaryBullets: An electrical fire originated in a utility room located in the second basement level of the Orchard Gateway shopping center.
Emergency protocols resulted in the immediate evacuation of approximately 100 people from the premises.
The incident was confined to electrical equipment within the facility's designated equipment room.
aiContextParagraph: Orchard Gateway is a prominent shopping mall situated in the Orchard Road district of Singapore. On November 9, 2026, the facility experienced a fire incident that necessitated the removal of occupants from the building to ensure public safety. According to reports, the fire started within an equipment room located at basement level two of the retail complex. The source of the combustion was identified as electrical equipment housed within that room. Local emergency services managed the situation, resulting in the evacuation of about 100 people. While the fire caused a disruption to standard mall operations, no injuries or further structural damage were reported following the intervention. The event drew significant local attention, reflected by increased search activity regarding the status of the commercial venue during the immediate aftermath of the evacuation procedure.
whyItIsViral: The story gained traction due to high public search interest regarding the safety status of a major shopping mall in Singapore following the evacuation.
